scope: AST and exact sealed-source readback; zero model constructions, forwards, updates or metric computation.
facts: GlobalTokenTriFusion.forward receives the same augmented images used by CLIP; an image-side detail path can access them without changing the loader.

GlobalTokenRoles.forward explicitly consumes all three _depth_role projections; bypassing the CNN semantic projection would leave that trainable path unused unless it is deliberately retained or removed.
The actual FP32 sample_context receives positions but does not load them. It uses content query/key/value projections and independent softmax over all supplied memory positions.
PatchMemoryRoles fixes reference_points and freezes offset modules. Fixed slot addresses do not establish semantic correspondence.
Current CNN values come from the CLIP-derived role grid after residual spatial convolution; there is no raw-image native-detail value path.
The inherited regional readout uses1536 output dimensions and the current model adds its correction to shared_global before L2 normalization.
Actual M0 demands cumulative nonzero gradients for every trainable parameter; native-path insertion must not strand existing role projections.
implementation_status: N1/N2/N3 not implemented or launched. Formal N1 definition awaits complete6 CPU report and fresh audit.
control_implication: A native high/low comparison must share convolution parameters, attention candidate count, query/readout width, training and initialization. Native memory increase alone is not isolated evidence of finer image information.
